parameters.system_prompt: You are an expert 3D low-poly papercraft designer, origami artist, and 3D unfold engineer. You design foldable low-poly figures made of simple primary geometric volumes where micro-details are illustrated flat on the paper surface. You follow the studio signature aesthetic: cute expressive eyes with circular white catchlights and vibrant paper colors. You generate exactly one image that follows all instructions. Never write any text, letters, watermark or labels. Every rule is mandatory and none may be broken.
parameters.negative_prompt: shadow, floor shadow, ground shadow, drop shadow, contact shadow, ambient occlusion beneath model, cast shadow, dark ground, black outlines, black crease lines, ink borders, cartoon outlines, wireframe lines, dark edge seams, 3D extruded teeth, jagged 3D spikes, open mouth cavity, eye level perspective, front view, side profile view, extra eyes, three eyes, one eye, floating eyes, gradients, text, watermark, labels, cell divider borders

prompt_templates.specific_subject:
papikapi-style low-poly papercraft figure of {subject}. One reference sheet holding a strict grid of 3 columns and 2 rows (6 equal rectangular cells, 3:2 aspect ratio). Each cell holds one complete 3D low-poly papercraft figure seen in a STRICT ORTHOGONAL AXONOMETRIC PERSPECTIVE FROM TOP-RIGHT CORNER (fixed camera angle identical for all models: 35° elevation from ground, 45° rotation, showing top, front, and right-side facets simultaneously).

Subject: {subject}.

{reference_instruction}

STUDIO INVARIANTS (MANDATORY):
- STRICT ORTHOGONAL AXONOMETRIC VIEW: Every model must be rendered in the exact same top-right orthogonal axonometric angle. Never eye-level, never flat front, never side profile.
- ABSOLUTELY ZERO SHADOWS: The entire canvas is a completely plain, seamless flat neutral light grey #E5E5E5 background. ZERO floor shadows, ZERO cast shadows, ZERO contact shadows under feet, ZERO ambient occlusion. The model rests shadowless on the plain background.
- ZERO BLACK CREASE LINES: Facets and edges are defined purely by directional lighting and solid paper colors. ABSOLUTELY ZERO black outline strokes, ZERO dark ink borders, ZERO wireframe lines, ZERO cartoon borders.
- 100% CLOSED GEOMETRIC VOLUMES: Muzzles, jaws, limbs, and heads are closed solid low-poly polyhedra. All mouths are closed.
- FLAT 2D UV TEXTURE DECALS: Teeth, claws, whiskers, nostrils, spots (cheetah, dalmatian), stripes (zebra, tabby), and patches (calico) are 100% FLAT 2D DECALS printed directly on the facet surfaces (UV map style). Teeth are flat sawtooth decals on closed jaws, NEVER protruding 3D physical spikes, cutouts, or open cavities.
- EXACTLY TWO EYES per figure: large cute round eye decals with circular white catchlights painted flat onto head facets. Never three eyes, never floating eyes.
- No shadows, no gradients, no text, no labels, no cell dividers.

parameters.reference_note_template: VISUAL REFERENCE CONDITIONING ({count} attached image(s)): Faithfully preserve the subject's identity, pose, proportions, colors, markings, and distinctive features shown in the reference photo, but translate them into clean planar low-poly facets WITHOUT black outline strokes, WITHOUT drawn black crease lines, and WITHOUT cartoon borders. Maintain the strict orthogonal axonometric top-right viewpoint, closed solid jaws, flat 2D UV texture decals for teeth and spots, exactly two eyes, and ABSOLUTELY ZERO FLOOR SHADOWS.

Cell (0,2) [Top-Right] (Default Pick #3): Studio signature training style — balanced geometric proportions, expressive signature eyes with white catchlight, exact reference colors and features, translated into clean planar facets without black crease lines and with flat 2D UV texture details on closed volumes in strict orthogonal axonometry
Cell (1,0) [Bottom-Left] (Pick #4): Classic structured papercraft model with elegant faceted planes and precise anatomical structure matching the signature palette in strict orthogonal axonometry
Cell (1,1) [Bottom-Center]: Sophisticated detailed papercraft sculpture with refined angular facets and dynamic posture in strict orthogonal axonometry

critical_rules: Strict 3x2 grid of exactly 6 equal cells: exactly 3 columns (left, center, right) and exactly 2 rows (top, bottom). Exactly one figure per cell, totaling exactly 6 figures. Never 4 columns, never 7 or 8 figures.
Strict orthogonal axonometric perspective from the top-right corner in EVERY cell (identical 35° elevation, 45° rotation showing top, front, and right facets).
Zero text, zero labels, zero words, zero letters anywhere on the canvas.
Every figure is complete, centered in its cell, on flat neutral #E5E5E5 background with ABSOLUTELY ZERO FLOOR SHADOWS, zero drop shadows, zero contact shadows beneath the figures.
Zero black crease lines: planes are defined by flat shading and pure facet colors, not drawn ink borders or dark seam lines.
Exactly two eyes per figure: large cute round eyes with a prominent white circular catchlight reflection painted flat onto the facet. Never three eyes.

Flat surface 2D UV texture details: teeth, claws, whiskers, eyes, spots, stripes, and fur textures are painted flat onto closed facet surfaces, NEVER modeled as protruding 3D spikes or open mouth cavities.
100% closed foldable primary volumes: all snouts, jaws, and limbs are closed solid geometric blocks suitable for papercraft folding.
self_check: Are there exactly 6 cells arranged in a 3x2 grid?
Is every cell drawn in the identical orthogonal axonometric top-right view?
Is there zero text and zero divider borders anywhere?
Is the background completely plain and flat with ABSOLUTELY ZERO FLOOR SHADOWS beneath the figures?
Are the figures clean planar low-poly facets without black outline strokes or cartoon ink lines?
Does every figure have EXACTLY TWO cute eyes with white catchlight reflection?
Are teeth, claws, whiskers, stripes, and spots painted flat onto closed facet surfaces rather than separate 3D spikes or open mouth cavities?
